stages.english: Sample A has a mass of 5 grams. Sample B has a mass of 7 grams.
stages.chinese: 样品 A 的质量是 5 克，样品 B 的质量是 7 克。

stages.english: Its temperature is 20 degrees Celsius. The speaker has not yet said which sample this temperature belongs to.
stages.chinese: 它的温度是 20 摄氏度，讲述者尚未说明这个温度属于哪个样品。

stages.english: The earlier temperature of 20 degrees Celsius belongs to sample A. It was measured before heating.
stages.chinese: 先前提到的 20 摄氏度属于样品 A，是加热前测得的温度。

stages.english: Sample B has a temperature of 30 degrees Celsius before heating. This is a separate measurement, not a change in sample A.
stages.chinese: 样品 B 加热前的温度是 30 摄氏度，这是另一项测量，并非样品 A 的温度变化。
